details.description: Llama 3.1 405B Instruct is the largest, instruction-tuned model in Meta's Llama 3.1 family, a multilingual large language model Meta released July 23, 2024. It has a 128,000-token context window and a knowledge cutoff of December 2023, and Meta names English, German, French, Italian, Portuguese, Hindi, Spanish and Thai as its officially supported languages. It is built for assistant-style chat, complex reasoning, coding and agentic tool use, and Meta says its evaluation across more than 150 benchmark datasets found it competitive with leading models including GPT-4o and Claude 3.5 Sonnet.
advantages: Scores 87.3 on MMLU, 89.0% on HumanEval, 96.8% on GSM-8K (CoT) and 50.7% on GPQA, per Meta's Llama 3.1 model card.
Scores 92.0% on the API-Bank tool-use benchmark and 88.6 on IFEval, per Meta's Llama 3.1 model card.
128,000-token context window, versus 8,192 tokens in the original Llama 3 models, per Meta's Llama 3.1 launch post.
disadvantages: Knowledge cutoff of December 2023, per Meta's Llama 3.1 model card.
Officially supported for only eight languages; other languages are not covered by Meta's safety and helpfulness evaluations.
use_cases: Multilingual conversational agents across the eight supported languages
Coding assistants and agentic systems using function calling and external tools
Synthetic data generation and distillation into smaller models

notes: Fireworks' own model page lists a 131,100-token context length; kept the catalog's 128,000-token facts value, which matches Meta's own published figure, instead.
